title: Transpose retraction induced by a local section
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], f:P → Q a morphism of O_X-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and U an open. If s:Q|_U → P|_U satisfies s followed by f|_U equal to id_Q|_U [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], the restriction of dualMap f:Hom(Q,O_X) → Hom(P,O_X) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] admits a left inverse. No epimorphism or finiteness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 0EKP, proof of (2) to (3), taking the dual of the surjection; local-splitting details expanded from the finite-basis argument. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EKP.

proof.text: Transport s to the over category using overFunctorEquiv and overEquiv. Internal Hom commutes with open restriction via SheafOfModules.overHomObjIso. Under this isomorphism the restriction of dualMap f is precomposition with f|_U. Precomposition with s defines the retraction on every smaller open; these maps commute with restriction. Contravariant functoriality identifies their composite with precomposition with s followed by f|_U, which is the identity by the hypothesis. Transport back through the two isomorphisms to obtain a split monomorphism of restricted scheme modules.
